pitfalls.problem: venice-repo-requirements-audit.yml push trigger is filtered to branches ['venice/repo-requirements-audit-v1'] and the checkout step pins ref venice/repo-requirements-audit-v1, so pushes to the active venice/repo-hierarchical-audit-v2 never run the audit and any run would test the wrong tree.
pitfalls.failed_approach: Assuming a push to the active audit branch would start the audit workflow.
pitfalls.lesson: Update both the workflow branches filter and the checkout ref to venice/repo-hierarchical-audit-v2 (and keep paths narrow) as part of the v2 change before expecting a green run.
